notes.title: My new game!
notes.notes:
Hey there!
I'm really happy to announce my new game: [b]Black Mountain Kings[/b] !

It is a 2D topdown action RPG, focused on combat and giving the player as much freedom as possible to explore the world!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qsbIRcA.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2633460/Black_Mountain_Kings/]Wishlist now![/url]

notes.title: Update - v1.3.0
notes.notes:
Hey guys! How are you all doing?
Here's a small update that I believe will make the post-game more interesting!

What changed?

[b]Breeding![/b]

Now demons inherit one skill from their other parent.
To breed demons you still need two adult demons, at least one free cage, and a little bit of luck. And that's it.

notes.title: Update - v1.2.0
notes.notes:
Hey guys! It's been a while, but here's a small but significative update!

What changed:
	-Days are shorter 
	-Training times are even shorter
	-Easier to fill the 'bonus xp' bar
	-Added a description to the different types of food (go to the 'NatuFoods' app and keep the cursor still for 1 second to see the description)
